item.title: Introduction to Compilers and Language Design
item.description:
📝 A compiler translates a program written in a high level language into a program written in a lower level language. This book offers a one semester introduction into compiler construction, enabling the reader to build a simple compiler that accepts a C-like language and translates it into working X86 or ARM assembly language. Instead of copying PDFs locally, please point students to this page (compilerbook.
🔗 Read more: https://dthain.github.io/books/compiler/
